name: chad-review
description: 9-pass autonomous pre-commit code review skill. Runs structural, behavioral, spec-drift, test, test-coverage, observability, documentation, adversarial, and dependency-freshness analysis on uncommitted working-tree changes (or the last commit if clean). Diff-shape aware: docs-only, config-only, deps-only, and tiny diffs skip the full sub-agent fan-out. Parallel sub-agent execution with sonnet/opus model tiering, read-only, never edits or commits.
